To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Leadership styles and psychological empowerment are important predictors of nurses’ commitment to their organization, and that transformational leadership is not associated with commitment”.

the study findings suggest that transformational leadership style, laissez-faire leadership and psychological empowerment are important predictors of commitment in the context of the Saudi Arabian healthcare system.
nurses’ commitment to their organization is positively associated with their perception of their managers’ TAL and negatively associated with their TFL and LFL style.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of leadership and empowerment on nurses’ organizational commitment.
the impact of leadership styles on the organizational commitment of nurses in acute care settings.
the effects of leadership and employee empowerment on organizational commitment, and how these factors can help in improving the quality of care provided by nurses to their patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the leadership styles and psychological empowerment have a significant effect on nurses’ organizational commitment.

the more nurses are committed to their organizations, the higher the quality of patient care, the more efficient the health care delivery, and the more effective the use of the health resources in acute health care setting in Saudi Arabia.

leadership styles and psychological empowerment are significantly associated with organizational commitment, but only to a certain extent, and that there are some factors that may moderate the effect of leadership styles on commitment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more nurses perceive their managers’ leadership style to be transformational, the less they will feel committed to their organizations, and the more they feel empowered the less they will commit.
the leadership styles of managers, and psychological empowering factors, have a positive influence on nurses’ organizational commitment.
the more transformational and transactional leadership behaviors, the more psychological empowerment, the higher organizational commitment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
managers should be encouraged to develop their leadership skills, and to promote a culture of empowerment, in order to enhance nurses’ commitment.

the leadership style and empowerment of nurses in acute health care units can be improved by focusing on the transactional leadership style of managers, as this was positively related to organizational commitment.
nurses’ commitment to their organization can be improved through the use of transformational, transactional, and laissez-faire leadership styles, and through the promotion of empowerment.
